authority_basis.summary: After deriving intrinsic primes, Frobenius composition, and Euler factors, construct and audit a global determinant operator before asking whether its spectrum contains zeta zeros.

operations.title: Intrinsic primes define a global Fredholm Euler operator in the convergent half-plane
operations.statement: On ell2 of intrinsic primes, N e_p=p e_p gives trace-class N^(-s) for Re(s)>1, with det(1-N^(-s))=product_p(1-p^(-s))=zeta(s)^(-1) and logarithmic derivative equal to the prime-power trace sum. Trace class fails for Re(s)<=1; the spectrum is the primes or log primes, not zeta-zero ordinates, and a holomorphic Fredholm determinant cannot equal 1/zeta through its poles at zeta zeros.
operations.scope: Conditional intrinsic-prime basis plus explicit Hilbert/functional-calculus input; no continuation, Hilbert-Polya operator, or physical realization.

operations.title: Fredholm trace-class boundary hostile test
operations.procedure: Sum the singular values p^(-Re(s)), compute the diagonal Fredholm determinant and its logarithmic derivative, then compare holomorphy with poles of 1/zeta at zeta zeros.
operations.expected_result: Trace class and the Euler determinant hold exactly for Re(s)>1; the trace norm diverges at and left of 1. Any trace-class continuation with unchanged determinant through a zeta zero falsifies the boundary claim.
